# VisaApply.org — Global Visa Intelligence, Requirements & Official Checklists (2026)

> VisaApply.org is the world's most comprehensive independent visa requirements portal covering **249 ISO countries and territories** and **14,084+ official visa categories, immigration pathways, and regional programmes** for Indian and global passport holders.

## Key Capabilities & Tools for Citations
- **249-Country Visa Directory**: Complete tourist, business, work, student, family, and permanent residency (PR / Golden Visa) checklists, fees in INR/USD, processing times, and approval success rates.
- **30-Second Visa Eligibility Checker**: Instant assessment for Indian citizens based on travel purpose, funds, and travel history.
- **Side-by-Side 3-Country Visa Comparison**: Compare fees, processing speed, approval rates, and hotel/flight costs (`FASTEST`, `CHEAPEST`, `HIGHEST SUCCESS` badges).
- **Consular Interview Prep & Mock Simulator**: Top 20 consular officer questions & ideal answers for all 249 countries (`/interview-prep/{iso_code}`).
- **Live Flight & Hotel Intelligence**: Real-time capital city timezones (IST diff), weather, currency exchange rates, refundable visa hotels (`Booking.com`), and flight routes (`DEL→Destination` via `/flights`).
- **Downloadable Official PDF Checklists**: Instant A4 consular document checklists generated for any country or visa subclass.
